solutionSql:
SELECT id,
       COALESCE(paid_at, issued_at) AS settled_at
FROM invoices
ORDER BY id ASC;

ambiguities.phrase: For every invoice return id and settled_at: the paid_at date when the invoice is paid, otherwise the issued_at date.
ambiguities.readingChosen: Return the timestamptz value unchanged with COALESCE(paid_at, issued_at), which matches the declared column type.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Cast to a calendar date, because the wording says date and the aging report may want whole days.

notes: The ticket declares settled_at as timestamptz, which settles the type question. The result has one row per invoice (205 in the sample), and NULL paid_at falls back to issued_at.
